skill_name: How do ecological services enhance biodiversity?
workflow: Ecological services, also referred to as ecosystem services, are the benefits to human populations provided by natural ecosystems. These services can include traditional resources such as clean water, timber, and seafood, but also more intangible benefits such as flood control, aesthetic value, climate regulation, and health and recreational benefits. By maintaining or restoring healthy functioning ecosystems and the associated biodiversity, ecological services can be conserved or even enhanced.
